title: Connector input keys loose ends after #33614: stale path-required comment, changeset hint, connector pull undeclared keys
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwhJBt274G7zk78A5a

Loose ends of #33553, left after PR #33614 merged (review#2 PASS record 6889245825). p3, one card.

- **N5.** `packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts` `buildInputSchema` still carries a "Path params are always required" comment; since #33614 the `path` section is required only when it declares a parameter.
- **N6.** The #33553 changeset could tell OpenAPI connector users how to fix a newly refused key: declare the parameter in the packaged OpenAPI document. The shipped Stripe and DocuSign documents declare 0 header parameters, so a per-call header is now refused for them.
- **Connector pull door.** `connectorSource.input` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`) does not opt into the undeclared-key judge, so undeclared top-level and query keys are still sent there (pinned as current behaviour by #33614's door-level test). Decide whether the pull door should judge the same way as `connector_action`; if yes it is a narrowing with its own Clause-②/Metadata-protocol answer.

Area: A5. Resume-from: main after #33614.
